name: Horror Night
description: Darker and colder than Movie Night — dread instead of comfort. The screen bias goes sickly moonlight green: a cold, desaturated glow behind the monitor that keeps eye strain down while reading as morgue light, not cinema warmth. Overheads cut completely. The floor lamp is a single deep blood-red ember, uplit from below eye level so it looms rather than illuminates. The cold-front / warm-floor tension is what makes a room feel wrong — exactly what you want with the lights off in October.
